title: verify-home-release
responsibility: Verifies that the signed-in Hub Home Agents card counts the live Tracker sessions across the requested computers.

inputs.name: verifyHubHomeRelease.nodes
inputs.description: Tracker node names of the online computers included in the release check.

inputs.name: verifyHubHomeRelease.readSummary
inputs.description: Reads the settled Agents card summary from signed-in Hub Home between Tracker samples.

inputs.name: verifyHubHomeRelease.fetcher
inputs.description: Reads the local Tracker API. Defaults to the runtime fetch implementation.

outputs.name: verifyHubHomeRelease
outputs.type: Promise<{ from: string; to: string; home: { working: number; sessions: number }; tracker: { node: string; sessions: number }[]; total: number }>
outputs.description: Sample times, displayed working and session counts, live counts by computer, and the total across the requested computers.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Tracker data was inaccessible, invalid, incomplete or changing, or the Hub summary could not be read or did not match the live session total.
